inner.title: fix the 1%
inner.body: microsoft's 2002 error reports showed 1% of bugs caused half of all errors. most founders fix whatever they saw last.
inner.label: 1% = half

inner.title: score it first
inner.body: ice rates impact, confidence and ease from 1 to 10, then multiplies them. a fix you can't score is just a guess.
inner.label: i x c x e

inner.title: kill the backlog
inner.body: linear fixes urgent bugs within 2 days, the rest within 7, and removed the backlog option. a backlog is a list you agreed to ignore.
inner.label: 7 day rule

inner.title: ship it small
inner.body: dora's 2024 elite teams deploy on demand and 5% of changes fail. low performers ship monthly and 40% fail.
inner.label: 5% vs 40%

inner.title: log the win
inner.body: a harvard study of 12,000 work diaries found progress on meaningful work beat every other motivator. only 5% of managers guessed it.
inner.label: small wins
